competitor_discovery.note: The 20 rows labs_competitors_domain returned (exclude_top_domains true, limit 20), by shared keywords. authority_comparison.note: DataForSEO domain rank (0 to 100, from backlinks). It is not Moz Domain Authority or Ahrefs Domain Rating. Organic keywords and visits are US estimates from labs_competitors_domain. The link gap is each competitor's referring main domains divided by ours.

keyword_gap.cut_note: No cut: each call returned every row that matched the filter, under the 500 limit.
